source.paper: He et al. (2026), Uncertainty-Guided Decision-Making in Bumble Bees, bioRxiv preprint
source.license_caution: Repository data directory refers to LICENSE, but license file was not found in root at audit time; raw data are not redistributed.

contract.warning: Free-Cue trials all have Info_Requested=1, whether or not the bee landed. Do not fit information seeking pooled across trial types using Info_Requested as a universal active behavior measure.

comparison.method: Free-Cue minus Regular landing rate, cluster bootstrap at bee level, B=3000, xorshift32 seed 0x8E4C19, percentiles [2.5,97.5]

inference_boundaries: No independent calibration of dynamic ecological transition rates in this task.
No randomized same-duration sham WAIT without informative cue.
Task difficulty (Easy/Hard/Impossible) does not alone establish a Blackwell ordered, temporally stale environmental-state cue family.
Free-Cue intervention may change salience, motor approach or timing in addition to information access.
Information request action is not identified by Info_Requested in Free-Cue trials; use Actually_Landed_On_Platform.
Differences are descriptive trial-type contrasts, not conditional information fitness or genetic selection.
Raw data remain at original third-party repository; receipt stores only audited aggregates.
proposed_followup: Use this dataset only to motivate and check active-information-seeking measurement. For the dynamic ecology hypothesis, preregister the matched SKIP/SHAM-WAIT/QUERY experiment with state transitions and both final action and post-query timing.
